mapper.select: SELECT source_id, content_hash, vector_ids, chunk_count, status, created_at, updated_at FROM rag_document_manifest WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY source_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_document_manifest ( source_id, content_hash, vector_ids, chunk_count, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{sourceId}, #{contentHash}, #{vectorIds, typeHandler=com.czf.czfaiagent.rag.etl.CustomerServiceVectorIdsTypeHandler}, #{chunkCount}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (source_id) DO UPDATE SET content_hash = EXCLUDED.content_hash, vector_ids = EXCLUDED.vector_ids, chunk_count = EXCLUDED.chunk_count, status = EXCLUDED.status, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
